title: Record review discussions
responsibility: Commit a new discussion thread or append a validated message linked to its prior content.

inputs.name: planThread.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planThread.input
inputs.description: Unit, author, optional title/message and viewed revision; use all-null image fields for an entity thread, or a complete matching image anchor and optional normalized region/option.

inputs.name: append.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: append.input
inputs.description: Unit and thread ID plus author, body, plan/change mode and optional agent, artifact references and change details.

outputs.name: planThread
outputs.description: Commit metadata and the new thread, sequential pin and optional first message. Image anchors are checked at the viewed revision and current plan.

outputs.name: append
outputs.description: Commit metadata and appended message with sequence, prior-content hash, timestamp and defaults for optional references/change fields.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid authors/messages/references, partial or mismatched image anchors, missing threads, unapproved or mismatched changes, unsafe paths and dirty/conflicting writes.
